text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby appropriated, out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be at the disposal of the Director of Public
Works for the purposes mentioned hereunder, subject to the provisions hereinafter set forth.
COMPLETION AND MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC BUILDINGS AND OTHER UNCLASSIFIED
For the purchase and construction of masts and towers for radio stations
For the maintenance, alteration, improvement, and repair of public buildings, including adjacent lands
belonging to the same
400,000.00
Provided, however, That a sum not to exceed P7,600 shall be set aside out of this item as reimbursement to the
lessee of the Sisiman Slaughterhouse for expenses incurred by him during the year 1922 for the alteration and
improvement of the water system of the slaughterhouse and the stockyards at Sisiman, Mariveles, Bataan, and
for the payment of the surcharge of the Bureau of Public Works.
Provided, further, That there shall be set aside a sum not to exceed P13,000 for the completion of the chemical
laboratory of the University of the Philippines.

CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE OF ROADS AND BRIDGES

For the maintenance and improvement of the Benguet and Naguilian Roads and the road from Camp One to

For the maintenance, reconstruction, and improvement of trails, roads, and bridges in such specially organized

For the maintenance, reconstruction, and improvement of the Manila North and South Roads traversing the

For the construction, reconstruction, and improvement of roads and bridges in such regularly organized
provinces as shall comply with the provisions of section 2113 of Act No. 2711 and which, by resolution of the
provincial board, shall guarantee by continuing annual appropriations the establishment of such a system of
maintenance as may be necessary in the judgment of the Director of Public Works on all first-class roads now
constructed or which may be constructed in the future and declared as such by the Director of Pubic Works
950,000.00

CONSTRUCTION OF ARTESIAN WELLS AND WATERWORKS
For drilling of artesian wells by the Bureau of Public Works, including the purchase of necessary equipment,
and for the investigation and construction of Insular, provincial, and municipal waterworks, whenever, in
cases of provincial and municipal projects, the provinces and municipalities concerned shall adopt resolutions
for the appropriation of funds covering the cost of one-third of the work.
500,000.00
Provided, That the funds appropriated by provinces and municipalities to cover the cost of one-third of the
work shall be paid into the Insular Treasury when the Director of Public Work's shall have paid the cost
thereof: Provided further, That any municipality or province which by virtue of the provisions of this Act shall
incur the expense of an artesian well resulting in a failure, shall have the amounts expended returned to it:
Provided finally, That the amount allotted out of this appropriation to a municipality or province as Insular aid
shall in no case exceed atone time the sum of twenty thousand pesos.
Total available for the construction of artesian wells and waterworks

500,000.00
PORT AND RIVER IMPROVEMENTS
For the maintenance, reconstruction, completion, and improvement of wharves and piers and dredging in the
specially organized provinces
80,000.00
For the construction, completion, and maintenance of wharves, piers, retaining walls, and other works
necessary for the regulation of rivers or the sea; the investigation of the condition of the bottom of ports and
rivers; the purchase, maintenance, and repair of equipment for port works, and dredging of harbors in the
various districts of the Archipelago
1,000,000.00
Provided, That subject to the approval of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications and with such
security as he may require, material derived from dredging may be used for filling in private property at the
request of any landowner, upon the condition that the cost thereof shall be paid by the owner of the land in
annual installments not to extend over more than five years: And provided further, That claims for damages
due to marine accidents incidental to the operation of port equipment may be paid subject to like approval.
The total of such payments out of funds appropriated by this subsection shall not exceed ten thousand pesos.

All balances of the several appropriations made by this Act the destination of which has not yet
been determined by the proper authority on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-four, and all balances
of appropriations which remain unexpended on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-five, shall revert
to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury, and thereafter shall not be available for expenditure
except upon appropriation by the Legislature.

The sums appropriated in subsections (a), (d), (f), (j), and (p) of this Act shall be available for
immediate expenditure by the Director of Public Works, but those of appropriated in the other paragraphs
shall be distributed in the discretion of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications, subject to the
approval of a joint committee elected by the Senate and the House of Representatives:
Provided, That the Secretary of Commerce and Communications, with the approval of said joint committee,
may, for the purposes of said distribution, transfer unexpended portions of any item of appropriation under
this Act to any other item hereunder.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 19, 1923.
